invariant: The members' attachment set (read and create on sys_attachment, no edit, no delete) is contributed to the additive member baseline (ADR-0090 D5) only when all four attachment gates are installed — the per-object opt-in (enable.files), the write rule, the read-visibility gate and the download door's parent-record check, each the storage service's own. Three of the four flags are their installation's own answer (the opt-in installer's return, the middleware seam the read-visibility gate is installed on, the download door's binding); the write-rule flag is a literal true, true because it is reached only in the branch that has just installed the write rule on the engine's hook seam. A kernel missing any of them grants nothing and says which gate is missing, so the object stays refused rather than ungated.
